stdout_matches: unsigned long vfmt\(unsigned char \*a0,unsigned long a1,unsigned long a2,unsigned long a3,unsigned long a4,unsigned long a5\)

notes: `lock` also states ARITY, so it needs a rule `types` does not: `vfmt` opens with the SysV register-save prologue a variadic gets from `va_start`, reads all six argument registers and recovers six parameters against the one its caller passes. A list ending on the LAST argument register is declined; without the rule the site renders five arguments nothing writes.
